scope: Prevent malformed DXF HEADER $UCSBASE and $PUCSBASE fields from being silently replaced by empty strings during typed output.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Header::write obtains both values through the destructive getStr helper and writes an empty group-2 string when the lookup does not return a string. Before this slice, a wrong variant type or group code therefore could be silently erased by output.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF HEADER Section Group Codes
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: $UCSBASE and $PUCSBASE are group-code 2 names of the UCS used as the base for orthographic UCS settings; PUCSBASE applies in paper space.
UCSBASE is a saved drawing string, defaults to an empty string, and accepts a named UCS.
PUCSBASE is a saved drawing string for paper-space orthographic UCS settings and defaults to an empty string.

implementationReadiness.change: Added a non-consuming preflight for both variables. It accepts absence or one canonical dollar/bare key whose value is a STRING at group 2. It refuses wrong types/groups, duplicate aliases, case-folded aliases, and known-variable entries placed in the custom map. Tolerant parsing remains unchanged; both direct HEADER output and whole-file DXF output preflight use the guard.

coverage: Valid nonempty $UCSBASE and $PUCSBASE names round-trip as group-2 strings in ASCII and Binary DXF.
Absent values serialize using the existing empty-string defaults.
Wrong value type, wrong group, duplicate dollar/bare aliases, and case-folded aliases are refused before publishing HEADER bytes.
Malformed input remains parseable and its wrong typed value remains available for diagnosis; typed output then refuses it.
A refused attempt rolls back its writer state, and the same writer accepts corrected names with typed readback.

limitations: This verifies field representation and atomic typed output only; it does not resolve either string to a UCS table record or qualify orthographic restoration in a native CAD consumer.
The P6 UCS base relation remains open. Do not promote nonzero DWG base-handle output from this DXF field guard.
The AGENTS.md ODA DWG specification PDF is unavailable at ~/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files.pdf in this environment; this slice changes no DWG byte layout.
nextReadyPacket: Obtain an eligible source and independent consumer evidence for UCSBASE/PUCSBASE table-name resolution and orthographic restoration. Keep current DWG base-handle output refusal until the previously identified group-79/group-346 source conflict is adjudicated.
